sources.name: Redox
sources.coverageNote: 636 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 1,502 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: 1,502 distinct product names recovered from the complete readable product lists in 14 of 15 public market pages. Building & Construction repeatedly timed out. Direct HTTP access and sitemap retrieval returned 403, so the supplier-wide catalog could not be independently reconciled. Product names, CAS values and classifications are supplier-published labels; technical correctness was not independently audited. Source URLs point to the market listings where each product is explicitly listed.

sources.name: Barentz
sources.coverageNote: 220 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 3,159 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: Enumerated every page of the public product search endpoint used by all 9 US vertical catalogs: Animal Nutrition, Personal Care, CASE, Human Nutrition, HI&I, Pharmaceuticals, Synthesis Solutions, Energy and Lubricants. The endpoint reported 3,438 listings across these catalogs; deduplication by published productId produced 3,160 unique product IDs. Imported 3,159 named records and excluded one unnamed empty source record. Distinct supplier product IDs are preserved even where the supplier repeats a product name. Complete for these public catalogs, with no claim about unpublished offerings. Product links use the supplier search form URL and exact product name because listings open details in a modal.

sources.name: ChemPoint
sources.coverageNote: 0 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 403 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: Direct HTTP catalog/sitemap requests returned 403, and the public search and all-manufacturers directories did not expose their dynamic result lists to web retrieval. Read all 20 manufacturer pages linked in the main navigation, recovered 128 product-family references, and systematically searched each family. This discovered 276 distinct US product-grade URLs; 275 pages returned verified product headings, while one returned 404 and was excluded. Includes 275 individual grades plus 128 explicitly labeled product-family references. Supplier-wide completeness cannot be established.

sources.name: Univar Solutions
sources.coverageNote: 74 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 1,240 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: 1,240 distinct published product numbers were verified in retrievable US category listings. 232 category/page URLs were checked: 112 yielded product records, 107 were unavailable and 13 were category landing pages without extractable product records. Direct catalog HTTP requests returned 403; web-retrieved listings include indexed/cached snapshots. Main category pagination was checked where totals were visible, and subsidiary category first pages were also included; additional pagination and account-only products remain unverified. Listing URLs are used for attribution because resolved individual product URLs were unavailable. Identical product names can have distinct published product numbers; preserve sourceProductId when deduplicating SKUs. No prices, availability, or missing technical properties are inferred.

sources.name: Brenntag
sources.coverageNote: 67 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 685 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: All 685 product cards in the US public product overview, with published CAS, INCI, industry and application labels from the same page. Brenntag describes this public overview as a selection of its offering; specialty/account-only records are not represented.

sources.name: Azelis Personal Care
sources.coverageNote: 15 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 566 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: Direct site, sitemap and public WordPress requests returned HTTP 403. Imported verified listings from 133 web-retrievable function/supplier directory pages plus indexed product pages. Followed every visible Next link until the chain ended or retrieval failed. Some directories or pagination pages were unavailable; full catalog completeness cannot be confirmed. Directory URLs identify the exact listing source when an individual product URL was not retrievable.

sources.name: IMCD
sources.coverageNote: 740 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 9,265 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: All public guest catalog pages across eight US business groups were retrieved through the same unauthenticated, 500-record search endpoint used by the public website. The site reports 11,746 results across those groups; deduplication by published product ID yields 9,265 distinct products. Product names are exact published labels and industry labels are from the published business groups. Full portfolio and documents may require MyIMCD login and are not included. Public product URLs are matched by product ID to the supplier sitemap; no URLs or technical properties were generated from names.

sources.name: Croda Beauty
sources.coverageNote: 3 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 277 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: Direct catalog and sitemap requests returned HTTP 403. Imported every distinct product ID found in systematic indexed searches across product families and functions. The dynamic Product Finder did not expose an enumerable public result set through available retrieval. This is a partial indexed subset, not the complete Croda catalog.

sources.name: Knowde
sources.coverageNote: 8 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 298 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: Partial public reference import: verified product cards from the main search and accessible category hubs. The main search reports 171,743 results but exposes 10 pages, and pagination, sitemap and some category requests returned HTTP 403. Full marketplace inventory could not be enumerated. Company names are the listed marketplace suppliers; source fields may be incomplete. No price or availability claims.

sources.name: New Directions Aromatics
sources.coverageNote: 479 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 920 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: All 920 public product-sitemap URLs verified: 918 products from all 10 Shop All catalog pages plus 2 additional Witch Hazel products verified on their product pages. Shop All reports 918; its sitemap lists 920. Supplier-listed INCI/CAS/custom categories included where present; prices, availability and unlisted properties omitted. Snapshot retrieved 2026-10-07.

sources.name: Ingredients Online
sources.coverageNote: 71 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 213 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: Partial public reference import from verified, search-indexed Ingredients Online product pages across ingredient families. The direct catalog, sitemap and robots requests returned HTTP 403; the readable catalog page exposed no product enumeration. No complete inventory total was available. Only exact product names, listed suppliers and explicitly visible CAS numbers were retained; no price or availability claims.

sources.name: BASF Personal Care
sources.coverageNote: 10 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 1,064 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: All 1,064 records returned by the public BASF Product Finder Personal Care industry facet (Care360 channel and EM catalog) were retrieved across all 11 pages. Product names come directly from structured source records. Detail fields are included only where retrieved; absent values are unknown. Most links use BASF product touchpoints, 10 use published sitemap URLs, and five newer records use the public source API detail URL.

sources.name: MakingCosmetics
sources.coverageNote: 743 generic cosmetic references retained after reviewing 1,260 imported records. Branded, company-specific and unresolved products were excluded. This is a selected reference catalog.
sources.retrievalNote: Current A–Z directory exactly matches the 1,103 existing product URLs. Public sitemap has 1,237 product URLs; its union with A–Z is 1,260. Verified all 157 additional sitemap product pages and included only those new records here; existing 1,103 records should be retained, giving 1,260 merged records. Includes packaging, equipment, kits and publications as well as ingredients. Supplier-labeled facts and public PDF document links included where present; no prices or availability imported. Snapshot retrieved 2026-10-07.

sources.name: Lotioncrafter

Snapshot retrieved 2026-10-07.
